title.narrative: Locally led development concepts on building effective, reliable, and sustainable Gambia Chamber of Commerce & Industry

description.narrative:
The action aims to improve the capacity of GCCI, promote the business community interests and support trade and investments in The Gambia through the following components:

(a) Completion of Trade Fair Centre

(b) Advocacy - National Business Council (NBC)

(c) Rural Out Reach Program

(d) Institutional Capacity Building

(e) Acquisition of Modern Office Equipment

(f) GCCI Strategic Plan

(g) Support to Trade Missions/Conferences
